result.reason: The redline appropriately limits renewals to 12 months and reduces the non-renewal notice period to 30 days, while preserving the bilateral termination right. However, it does not reach either playbook position because it includes no cap on renewal price increases; it also omits the 60-day Vendor reminder required by the preferred position. The changes made are targeted and professionally drafted, but the margin comment cannot cure the missing operative protections.
